topics.summary: The broadcast covers a range of topics including concerns about dangerous toys – notably exploding water balloon slingshots and flammable Mickey Mouse pillows – alongside commentary from the Americans for Democratic Action Consumer Affairs Committee, who highlight rising toy-related injuries. A heated exchange occurs during a presidential address in El Salvador when protestors heckle regarding human rights issues.

topics.title: Gossip & Anatomical Oddities
topics.summary: During a radio show segment, Howard Stern discusses personal gossip involving ‘Yenta,’ referencing persistent rumors about callers. He transitions to discussing his brother Anthony’s obsession with Italy and an unsettling fixation on “moon” and “parmesan.” The conversation then veers into bizarre tangents including speculation surrounding NBC chairman's behavior, outlandish claims of bestiality dial-a-date, a detailed description of cancer symptoms, and finally, a discussion about Donald Trump’s presidential candidacy alongside commentary regarding anal fissures.

topics.title: Jackie’s Ritual and Thanksgiving Turkeys
topics.summary: Jackie meticulously cleans his coffee cup by swishing it in the men's room sink, soaking it overnight daily, while studying a comedy newspaper and comparing hair tips with an unnamed woman. Later, 94 turkeys explode into the air during a promotional event.
